---
name: validate-site
description: Use for the validate site stage of building or repairing a website from a GitHub repository.
---

# Validate Site

Run install, lint, typecheck, tests, build, routes, assets, accessibility baseline as applicable. Mark PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/N/A and repair failures. Use scripts/site-builder/build.py for this site.

Read the repository assessment and current site manifest. Record evidence and changes in docs/site-builder/work-log.md. Continue to the next stage unless an actual external authorization boundary remains.
